  sort: "date desc"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 3

  sort-ui: false

page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<!-- Filter buttons, as on the Hugo Academic Projects widget (content/home/projects.md).
     They drive Quarto's own listing filter; "" shows all items. -->
<div class="btn-group project-filters mb-4" role="group" aria-label="Filter projects">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-category="">All</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-category="Kenya">Kenya</button>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".project-filters button");
  const select = (category) => {
    for (const b of buttons) {
      const on = b.dataset.category === category;
      b.classList.toggle("btn-primary", on);
      b.classList.toggle("btn-outline-primary", !on);
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on);
    }
  };
  for (const b of buttons) {
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.category)));
      select(b.dataset.category);
    });
  }
  // Reflect a #category=... link (e.g. from the tag cloud)
  const m = window.location.hash.match(/category=([^&]*)/);
  select(m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : "");
});
</script>
```
